exposure: β-human chorionic gonadotropin level at hospital admission
Case group: 63 failures of treatment for CSP
Vascularization at cesarean scar on ultrasound
Control group: 98 successes of treatment for CSP
outcome: Success rate of treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) using Foley insertion combined with fetal suction curettage
cohort: 161 women with CSPs ≤ 8 weeks treated at TuDu Hospital during September 2017-April 2019
finding: COS-2 + on ultrasound, no vascularization at cesarean scar on ultrasound, gestational mass volume ≤4 cm(3), and β-human chorionic gonadotropin at hospital admission ≤ 10,000 mIU/mL were significantly correlated with treatment success.
